name: Block the drive
summary: At the non-volley-zone line, block medium-pace fed drives softly into the non-volley zone; count blocks that land in the zone.
setup: Blocker at the non-volley-zone line; feeder at the baseline of the opposite side, in the same half
Feeder hits medium-pace drives from a bounce to the blocker's paddle side or body, one at a time; no full-power hits
Blocker absorbs the pace with a short, firm paddle and blocks the ball back softly into the non-volley zone
Sets of 20 feeds; swap roles after each set; count blocks that land in the zone
success_criterion: In each of 2 sets of 20 feeds, at least 12 blocks land in the non-volley zone
safety_notes: Fed drives come at the body: wear eye protection, feed at medium pace only and stop the set if a ball hits the face. Stop if in pain.
coach_rationale: (judgment) An error under pressure (a `forced_error`, AN-07 forced-error share) is most often a hard ball the player cannot control; a cooperative, medium-pace drive feed lets a beginner learn the soft block before live speed-ups. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
